one_line: Founder of the Vakataka dynasty, remembered in later inscriptions as a banner-bearing war leader of the early Deccan.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, athletic and wiry with a battle-hardened build
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, sharp dark eyebrows and a small vertical scar on the left cheek; default expression is calm and focused with a hint of wary determination
appearance.hair: thick black hair parted at the center, drawn back into a high knotted topknot (kaparda) at the crown with the rest tied into a short, tidy bun, held by a simple copper hair ring and a narrow dark-red cloth band around the forehead
appearance.costume: era-appropriate early-3rd-century Deccan attire: a knee-length off-white cotton dhoti wrapped and pleated forward in the Andhra–Deccan style with a neat front fan, a fitted short-sleeved reddish-brown cotton tunic reaching mid-thigh worn over the dhoti and belted at the waist with a plain dark leather belt, a long mustard-yellow angavastra draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back like a sash, and simple brown leather sandals; jewellery restricted to a thin copper torque, small copper stud earrings, and a single copper armlet on the right upper arm, all slightly worn to stress his early, unostentatious status
appearance.signature: a plain iron straight sword with a slightly leaf-shaped blade, a simple crossguard and a dark wooden hilt wrapped in leather, worn at his left side in a dark-brown scabbard suspended from his belt, plus a rolled, weathered palm-leaf manuscript bundle tucked at the back of his belt as a nod to the fragmentary records of his life

ref_desc: Vindhyashakti is a mid-30s, medium-brown Deccan man with an oval face, scarred left cheek, black hair in a high knotted topknot, wearing an off-white dhoti, reddish-brown tunic, mustard-yellow angavastra and copper ornaments, carrying a plain iron straight sword and a palm-leaf manuscript bundle in dark brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Vindhyashakti, founder of the Vakatakas: a mid-30s, athletic Deccan man with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, high cheekbones, a small vertical scar on his left cheek, sharp dark eyes and calm, focused expression, his thick black hair parted in the center and gathered into a high knotted topknot with a short bun held by a simple copper ring and a narrow dark-red forehead band; clothe him in early-3rd-century central Deccan attire with no anachronisms: a knee-length off-white cotton dhoti pleated forward, a fitted short-sleeved reddish-brown tunic reaching mid-thigh belted with a plain dark leather belt, and a long mustard-yellow angavastra draped from his left shoulder across his chest and around his back like a sash, plus simple brown leather sandals; add modest copper jewellery only—a thin torque, small stud earrings and a single right armlet—kept understated; his signature gear is a plain iron straight sword with a slightly leaf-shaped blade, simple crossguard and leather-wrapped wooden hilt in a dark-brown scabbard at his left hip, and a small rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tucked into the back of his belt, all rendered in a palette of off-white, reddish-brown, mustard yellow, dark brown and copper, with multiple poses and close-ups ensuring the face, topknot, garments and sword are clearly visible.
